summary: Iter93 Community Reviews - both backend and frontend end-to-end tested. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (categories seed+add, list places with sort/filter, submit/edit/delete review one-per-user upsert, anon vs name display, cross-account visibility, flag, admin gating 403 for non-admin, admin merge places dedupe path). Frontend UI: /reviews home loads via Settings and directly; Community Reviews title, chips (All + all 12 defaults incl. Coffee Shops, Restaurants/Eateries), 3 sort buttons (Top rated / Most reviewed / Newest), search + city inputs, + Category chip modal, and Add-review FAB all render correctly with mobile viewport. Added-category chip via modal appears in list. Add-review flow (FAB) creates a NEW place + review, redirects to /reviews/{place_id}, byline shows 'App R.' when anon OFF and 'Anonymous' when ON. Edit updates rating/body while review_count stays 1 (no duplicate). Toggling anon via inline editor works. Cross-account: place created by regular user IS visible to admin. Admin sees flag icon in /reviews header, git-merge icon on place detail, 'Delete (admin)' link on foreign reviews. Admin merge modal opens and lists other places. /reviews/flags loads and shows previously reported review (Torchy's Tacos • Dallas, Reason: spam) with Delete button.
critical_code_review_comments: reviews.py line 369: `db.review_flags.update_many({review_id in ...}, {$set: {}})` is a no-op (empty $set). Harmless but dead code — likely intended to migrate flags to the target place or delete them; either drop the line or replace with a deletion of stale flags for moved reviews (their ids don't change so it's not required for correctness).
reviews.py list_categories: place counts are computed per-category label but user-added categories with 0 places are fine; consider caching if many categories.

Frontend /reviews/[id].tsx: RN Alert.alert on native devices renders a real dialog, but on web it currently falls back to window.alert/confirm which cannot be intercepted via testID. Not a functional bug but a testing/UX consideration — an in-app confirmation modal would be more consistent.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all UI flows verified; RN Alert-based Report/Merge confirm dialogs harder to intercept in headless Playwright but underlying API paths validated via backend tests)

seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test data: TEST_Cat_* categories, TEST_Place_*, TEST_Anon_*, TEST_XAcc_*, TEST_MergeA/B_* places via pytest (cleaned up in-test). UI test also created a UITestCafe{ts} place in Austin (Coffee Shops) and two AdminMerge{A,B}{ts} places in Waco — these remain in the DB but are clearly TEST_ prefixed / obvious.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Community Reviews (iter93) fully working end-to-end. Reviews reached from Settings tab > 'Community Reviews' OR directly at /reviews. Login response uses 'access_token' (not 'token') — reused in test fixture. Star picker uses testID='star-{n}' (1..5); place detail uses testIDs edit-my-review, delete-my-review, admin-merge-btn, merge-target-{placeId}, save-detail-review. RN Alert-based confirms (Report / Merge / Delete-mine) are hard to click in Playwright on web — use the backend tests to validate those API paths.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial test-script hiccups fixed during run: (1) login token key is 'access_token' not 'token' (pytest fixture updated), (2) `page.get_by_text('Coffee Shops').first` collides with category chips both in /reviews and /reviews/new — resolved via .last / more specific locators.
